articles.title: German judge proposes dropping Movie2k case if operator hands over $2.56 billion in bitcoin

articles.title: Circle turns to DBS as banks build rival digital payment systems across Asia

articles.title: Blaming Anthropic’s IPO for bitcoin’s slide is 'easy to believe,' but flawed, analysts say
Bitcoin drops as Nvidia earnings report drives stock index futures higher
